svg.text: Bench wiring: Mainboard (ESP32 WROOM-32) and Controller (ESP32-C3 SuperMini)
Both boards powered from USB. Low voltage only: nothing on the relay contacts. Pills are connections to a breadboard rail or a named point. Wire by the labels printed on your boards.
Keep JD-VCC jumper on for the bench
IN1 G26 · IN2 G27 · IN3 G32 · IN4 G33
Later to the fan's 0-10 V input.
No fan yet? Leave the tach wire open and type: set fanfaultrpm 0
Bare EC11 encoder: A = CLK, B = DT, middle pin C = GND; one switch pin = SW, other = GND.
Mainboard G17 TX2 → Controller G20 RX
Mainboard G16 RX2 ← Controller G21 TX
Join the GND rails of both breadboards (needed for the link)
